title: studio: the view / page-block FilterBuilderField builds fields without multiple, so a multi-value field offers = / $in
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · same family as #35992 (found by area a4-D's dev, os-dev report 7066498044), outside that card's surface.

## What happens
Studio's view and page-block filter editor (`FilterBuilderField`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`) builds its field list without each field's `multiple`, so on a `multiple: true` field it offers and saves `=` / `$in`, which the data door refuses (400 `INVALID_FILTER`, #35559) and the dataset door answers wrongly. PR #36165 passes `multiple` to the shared builder for the other editors; this one is not covered.

## Done when
`FilterBuilderField` passes the field's `multiple` to the shared builder like the editors #36165 fixed, so a multi-value field offers the JSON-column operators; a pin on a `multiple: true` field with a scalar control.

reach: Studio form (a saved view / page-block filter), by code reading against the shared builder's contract fixed in #36165; to be measured once by the claimant.
Business reason: list views and page blocks authored in Studio on a multi-value field fail or show wrong rows.
Reader: a domain:ui lane (Studio metadata-admin widgets).
Dedupe: `FilterBuilderField multiple` → 0 hits.
Grade: p2 — same class as #35992's condition editors.
